page.overview:
What is Unidentified guild?

The Nautolan child Nakano Lash was sold to a guild after the death of her parents Lash was no longer part of the guild and operated as a bounty hunter. In 3 ABY, as she was trapped aboard her ship, the Nautolan told her protégé—the cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance—about the time she had been sold to the guild.

The guild was mentioned in the fifth issue of the 2020 comic series Star Wars: Bounty Hunters. The issue was written by Ethan Sacks and published by Marvel Comics
